task: Read all workbook sheets. All quantities and prices are integers. Corrections replace quantities by ID; absent corrections keep the original. IDs are unique, dependency edges are unique and acyclic. A higher Priority Rank is processed first; tied ranks use ascending ID. Make exactly one pass; rejected orders are never reconsidered. Start with empty selections and zero capacity usage. For each order compute Price times corrected quantity, then apply the FIRST matching reason: inactive status -> inactive; missing any Policy Cities -> city; amount strictly above Max per order -> per_order; any Dependencies prerequisite not already selected -> dependency; adding amount strictly exceeds its group's Limits Capacity -> group_cap; adding amount strictly exceeds Policy Budget -> budget; otherwise select with reason selected and consume group and total capacity. Equality to any limit is allowed. Dependencies are AND, absent dependencies mean none. Rejected orders consume nothing. Save Summary B2:B5 as selected sum, selected count, highest selected amount's ID (ties ascending ID), and that amount; if no selections use 0,0,NONE,0. Write Decisions with exactly one row per order in processing order: [ID, amount, selected 0 or 1, reason], using write_decisions. Write report.txt with explicit Total, Count, Winner, Amount fields. Save workbook and report before receive_update. After update re-read changed sheets, recompute ALL selections from scratch (no reservation from stage one), rewrite Decisions, Summary and report, save, then finish. This is deterministic greedy allocation, not global optimization.
